Me after **10 losses** in a row, risking 5% each:

caption:
3 green trades and suddenly trading is the best career on earth. 👑

Then the losing streak shows up. It always does, for every trader and every system.

The math from Lesson 07:
→ 10 losses in a row at 5% risk per trade: down about 40%
→ The same 10 losses at 1% risk: down about 9.6%

The streak is the same. Position size decides whether it's a bad week or the end of the account.

Tag the friend who ranks trading above every career after one good day. 😅
